exercises.title: Test Case Documentation
exercises.description: Add documentation and tags to organize test cases.
instructions: Add [Documentation] explaining it tests user authentication
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add test with documentation and tags
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
User Login Test
    [Documentation]    Tests user authentication functionality
    [Tags]    login    authentication
    Log    Testing user login
hints: [Documentation] comes first after test name
[Tags] comes after [Documentation]
Both use 4-space indentation
Documentation is a single line (or use ... for multi-line)

exercises.title: Multiple Test Cases
exercises.description: Organize multiple test cases in one suite.
instructions: Create 'Addition Test' that verifies 2+2=4 using Should Be Equal
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add two test cases
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Addition Test
    ${result}    Evaluate    2+2
    Should Be Equal    ${result}    ${4}

Subtraction Test
    ${result}    Evaluate    5-3
    Should Be Equal    ${result}    ${2}
hints: Separate test cases with blank line
Each test case starts with no indentation
Evaluate keyword can calculate expressions
Should Be Equal compares two values

exercises.title: Using Comments
exercises.description: Add comments to explain your code.
instructions: Add a comment: # Initialize test data
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add test with inline comments
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Documented Test
    # Initialize test data
    ${status}    Set Variable    active
    # Verify status
    Log    ${status}
hints: Comments start with #
Comments use same indentation as code
Comments are ignored during execution
Use comments to explain complex logic

exercises.title: Fix Spacing and Indentation
exercises.description: Fix a badly formatted test to follow RF conventions.
instructions: The initial code has spacing errors
Fix the indentation to use 4 spaces consistently
Fix keyword-argument spacing to use 4 spaces
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Badly Formatted Test
  Log  Hello
      Log  World
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Badly Formatted Test
    Log    Hello
    Log    World
hints: Test case body uses 4-space indentation
Keyword and arguments separated by 4 spaces
Consistent spacing is crucial in Robot Framework
Use spaces, not tabs

exercises.title: Complete Suite Structure
exercises.description: Create a properly organized test suite with all sections.
instructions: Add Settings section with Suite Setup logging 'Suite Started'
Add Test Cases section with test that logs ${APP_NAME}
Add Keywords section with 'Custom Keyword' that logs 'Custom'
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup    Log    Suite Started

*** Variables ***
${APP_NAME}    MyApp

*** Test Cases ***
Test App Name
    Log    ${APP_NAME}

*** Keywords ***
Custom Keyword
    Log    Custom
hints: Section order: Settings, Variables, Test Cases, Keywords
Variables section: ${name}    value
Each section starts with *** Section Name ***
Sections separated by blank lines
